evidence.note: Entry-closet doors are closed immediately before manipulation.
First closet door leaf is visibly swinging open.
Both closet door leaves are fully open, exposing coats and shoes.
This closet leaf begins swinging back toward the frame.
Both entry-closet doors are closed again.
Entry closet is closed.
Second door leaf is opening as the closet becomes fully exposed.
Both leaves are open.
User's hand is visible completing closure of the remaining leaf.
Entry closet is fully closed.
Laundry closet is closed and the user reaches a knob.
First laundry-closet door leaf is swinging outward.
Laundry machines are exposed with both leaves open.
User grasps a knob and starts closing this leaf.
One leaf is nearly closed while the other remains open.
Second laundry-closet leaf is being moved while the first is already open.
Both leaves are open and the stacked machines are unobstructed.
One remaining leaf is still open after the first has nearly closed.
Both laundry-closet leaves are shut.
Tall integrated refrigerator door is closed; user approaches its handle.
User pulls the refrigerator handle and the door begins opening.
Refrigerator is open and illuminated.
Refrigerator remains open immediately before closure.
Integrated refrigerator door is fully closed.
User reaches toward the upper spice-cabinet door.
Cabinet door is open, revealing jars and spices.
Cabinet remains open.
User pushes the cabinet door shut.
Upper cabinet is fully closed.
Lower kitchen drawer is closed and the user reaches for its pull.
Drawer has been pulled open, exposing utensils.
Drawer is fully open.
User pushes the open drawer inward.
Drawer is fully closed.

notes: Seven events are reported because the two independently movable leaves of both the entry closet and laundry closet are treated as separate interacted parts. Their individual timings are less certain because the manipulations occur close together and are partly occluded.
scene_description: First-person traversal of an apartment entryway and kitchen. The user opens and closes two entry coat-closet leaves, two laundry-closet leaves, an integrated refrigerator, an upper spice cabinet, and a lower utensil drawer.
